events.title: O-I Glass Q1 Earnings Call Highlights
events.body: O-I Glass (NYSE:OI) reported a challenging start to fiscal 2026, with first-quarter results pressured by sluggish early-quarter demand, elevated competitive pressure in Europe, and several one-time external disruptions that increased costs.
